statement: Community USB HID descriptor and compatibility feature documentation include GET feature 0x05 calibration (41 bytes total). Linux/SDL parse gyro bias/plus-minus/speed and accelerometer plus/minus endpoints as LE16 values; HHD emits a synthetic calibration reply for virtual operation.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: nondebug report-descriptor-usb.txt Feature 0x05; VIIPER docs 269-280; Linux 1023-1064; SDL 555-629. Source-dependent interpretation; no valid physical per-device calibration captured.
